standard.runs: Exactly one final normal/base STANDARD, SMP4; no benchmark in quick/scoped guard checks and no repeat for a better result
standard.assessment: Filesystem elapsed time per operation is about 17.1% above the frozen reference, with a stable current range of 52.57..54.26 ms and median 54.14 ms. This is an open performance observation beyond the prior local five-run median spread. Lifecycle is about 4.1% slower; scheduler, memory and IPC are about 1% faster. The changed fault capture runs on failures; its new entry reset also touches ordinary faults. No filesystem hotpath was changed. One run cannot identify a code, layout or host/storage cause, and does not prove a causal kernel regression or absence of one. Retain this result for the already mandatory following comparisons; no cherry-picked repetition or claimed performance gain
